      public PlayerDTO(Totem totem, String nickname, int food, int pp, boolean connected, List<Card> cards, List<Building> buildings, Map<String,Integer> characterCounts, int stars, int buildingDiscount, int sustainmentDiscount, Set<String> ownedTools)
      Full constructor used by Jackson deserialization.
      Parameters:
      totem - the player's totem
      nickname - the player's nickname
      food - the player's food
      pp - the player's prestige points

      cards - the player's cards
      buildings - the player's buildings

      stars - the player's stars
      buildingDiscount - the player's building discount
      sustainmentDiscount - the player's sustainment discount
      ownedTools - the names of the tools the player owns
